trap.label: conclude that
trap.wrong: From these premises, we conclude to that the argument fails.
trap.right: From these premises, we conclude that the argument fails.
trap.why: Em português “concluímos por/que” aceita preposição. Em inglês, conclude é seguido diretamente de that.

fix.wrong: The argument is valid but it isn’t sound, because the premise are false.
fix.right: The argument is valid but it isn’t sound, because the premise is false.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com therefore: “The premises are true, so the conclusion holds.” (Therefore…)
rewrite.answer: The premises are true; therefore, the conclusion holds.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no plural: “The premise is true.”
Reescreva com conclude: “We reach the result that it fails.”
